title: Actual normalized reconstruction over an arbitrary scheme
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and any scheme W. For the coefficient reduction/total-limit adjunction S of [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], the total limit of every normalized coefficient sequence is complete and its actual counit is an isomorphism. The actual unit of every complete object is an isomorphism. No invertibility condition on l on W is needed. Completeness and normalization are those of the existing coefficient system and normalized DVR tower definitions.

source.place: Adjunction, Unit and Counit paragraphs; the unrestricted version is the existing proof of purNormalizedReconstruction with its unused geometric binder omitted.

proof.text: Realize a normalized sequence by its canonical DVR tower. Apply effectivity and finite counit invertibility, and use conservative finite evaluations to invert the actual counit. For a complete object, compare its quotient tower with the reduction sequence using the K-flat transition formula and transport its Roos triangle. Uniqueness of derived limits and the adjunction triangle invert the actual unit. The auxiliary finite field is chosen with characteristic different from l; no property of W is used.

source.place: Normalized DVR effectivity and reconstruction from the canonical quotient tower; actual adjunction proof as in Sheaf.Paper.PurNormalizedReconstructionAdjunctionCalculus, purNormalizedReconstruction.

lean.statement:
theorem purNormalizedReconstructionOfScheme
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W) :
    (∀ (N : coefficientSequenceDerived l E W), IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence l E W N →
      IntegralOnSlice.IsComplete l E W none ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E W).obj N) ∧
        IsIso (S.adjunction.counit.app N)) ∧
    (∀ (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E W)),
      IntegralOnSlice.IsComplete l E W none K → IsIso (S.adjunction.unit.app K))
